Applicant :- Jagdish
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Dr. Gautam Chowdhary,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material brought on record.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that in the instant case, initially the applicant was granted bail in the year 2011 and he was continuously appearing before the trial court uptill 2019 but due to his non appearance before the concerned trial court on 06.03.2019 non bailable warrant was issued against him of which he was not having any knowledge and thereafter the applicant was arrested 29.01.2025 and since then he is in jail.
He further submits that the applicant had not deliberately absconded from the judicial proceedings and undertakes that he shall not repeat the same in future.

Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is in judicial custody since 29.01.2025,
and in case, applicant is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.

3. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.
4. Considering the overall facts and circumstances, the nature of allegations, the gravity of offence and without expressing any opinion on merits, this Court finds it to be a fit case for bail.
Accordingly, the bail application stands allowed.

5. Let the applicant-Jagdish, be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No. 1490 of 2010 (S.T. No. 428 of 2012), under Sections 307, 420, 467, 468, 413, 414 I.P.C., Police Station- Rajabpur, District- Amroha, on executing a personal bond and furnishing two local sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence.
ii) The applicant shall not threaten or harass the prosecution witnesses.
iii) The applicant shall appear on the date fixed by the trial court.
iv) The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which the applicant is accused, or suspected of the commission.
v) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade such person from disclosing facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
vi) Trial court is directed to make all possible efforts/ endeavour to conclude the trial expeditiously without giving any unnecessary adjournment to the applicant.
6. In case of default of any of the conditions enumerated above, the informant would be free to move an application for cancellation of bail before this Court.
Order Date :- 7.8.2025 Mustaqeem.
